name: @red-cup-engineering/semiotic-voxel-package-registry-service
description: Materializes and serves an npm-compatible registry from explicit semiotic-voxel package carriers.

scripts.verify: node --check src/package-registry.mjs && node --check src/cloudflare-worker.mjs && node --check src/snapshot.mjs && node --check src/protocol.mjs && node --check bin/fabricate-registry.mjs && node --check bin/serve-registry.mjs && node --check bin/execute-a2a-task.mjs && node --check bin/a2a-server.mjs && node --test test/*.test.mjs

provide-semiotic-voxel-package-registry.accepts: one explicit package-carrier set, artifact territory, public registry address, and compute-market or local-capacity ceiling
provide-semiotic-voxel-package-registry.returns: one package catalog preserving the declared actor-operation-capability-contract graph plus an npm-compatible read-only registry face and settled compute-use receipt

obtain-union-package-registry-snapshot.returns: one current private-registry snapshot preserving the declared actor-operation-capability-contract graph and scoped npm configuration
